meta.name: Kaale Dhande 720p
meta.description:
A young photographer's life turns upside down due to various unforeseen situations. Desperate to put things in order, he gets entangled into further mess.

Returning Series · First aired 2 Oct 2019 · Language: Hindi
Studio: Shaika Entertainment · Network: ZEE5

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Bird in the Bush
videos.overview: Vicky, a sex-craving young man, meets Swapnali, his new Facebook friend, for a booty call. The two decide to go to a popular make-out point. Accidentally, Vicky’s father’s friend spots them making out and narrates the incident to Vicky’s family.

videos.title: The Search is On
videos.overview: Vicky, Sam, and Sudarshan decide to play a prank on Kaka and introduce him to their friend Simran. Soon, Kaka starts texting Simran. Vicky and his friends then decide to set him up to meet Simran at a lodge to catch him red-handed.

videos.title: The Perfect Storm
videos.overview: Vicky, Sam, and Sudarshan blackmail Kaka and force him to sponsor a trip to Malaysia. Kaka ends up losing almost all his money. Fearing that the boys will blackmail him again in the future, he seeks help from Anna Bhai who gets the boys kidnapped and forces them to hand over all the evidence against Kaka. However, something unexpected happens.

videos.title: Between Two Burns
videos.overview: Bhai fears that his reputation will be at stake if the scandal goes public. To tackle this problem, he gives Vicky two options. Meanwhile, Kimaya finds out that her family is looking for a groom for her. She decides to tell her family about her relationship with Vicky and expects him to do the same. However, Vicky is under immense pressure as he's stuck between Bhai and Kimaya.

videos.title: Brains over Brawn
videos.overview: Vicky decides to reveal the truth to Kimaya but Sam advises him against it. The two then blackmail Kaka and take his help to stop Kimaya's wedding. Meanwhile, Bhai decides to meet Vicky’s family. Later, Kimaya’s family accepts her relationship with Vicky and asks Vicky to speak to his family.

videos.title: Treading on Thin Ice
videos.overview: Vicky promises Kimaya that he will speak with his family about their relationship. However, when he reaches home, he finds Bhai discussing  Vicky and Swapnali’s wedding with his family. Vicky gets furious with Kaka but finds out that Kaka had no choice but to help Bhai. Vicky confronts Bhai who threatens to kill Kimaya and his family if Vicky disobeys.

videos.title: It's Time to Settle Scores
videos.overview: Vicky, Kaka, Sudarshan, and Sam get drunk, and Vicky calls up Kimaya to reveal the truth to her. Upon hearing the truth, Kimaya is devastated. Vicky feels guilty about this. As the wedding preparations begin, Kimaya decides to move back to London but asks Vicky to meet her one last time.

videos.title: Found and Lost
videos.overview: It's D-Day, and Vicky has given up all hope of being with Kimaya. Later, Kaka helps him escape the wedding and go to the airport to stop Kimaya. At the airport, Vicky reveals the truth to Kimaya and the two seem to be happy. However, something is still amiss.
